Article Title: Mamata 2021 injury row: Ex-CM's lawyer sends notice to hospitals over medical record 'disclosure'

NEW DELHI: Former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee 's lawyer on Monday sent a legal notice to state-run SSKM Hospital and the Bangur Institute of Neurosciences over the alleged disclosure of her medical records from 2021 without the Trinamool Congress (TMC) supremo's permission, PTI reported.The development came two days after West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari alleged at a press conference in Kolkata that Mamata Banerjee had "faked" her leg injury during the 2021 state assembly elections, which the TMC eventually won.Adhikari, a former Trinamool leader who joined the BJP in December 2020, displayed a document that he claimed was the March 11, 2021, report of the Bangur Institute of Neurosciences' Department of Radio Diagnosis. He said the report showed "no evidence of a fracture."Adhikari also announced that the state government would launch a fresh inquiry into what he described as Banerjee's "false claims" about her leg injury during the 2021 assembly election campaign.Following this, Mamata Banerjee's lawyer, Arka Nag, sent the notice to the director and medical superintendent of SSKM Hospital and the head of the neurology department at the Bangur Institute of Neurosciences.He sought an explanation as to how his client's medical records reached Adhikari and were subsequently made public. A copy of the notice was also sent to the principal secretary of the state health department.The notice referred to statements made by the chief minister on October 3 and argued that even if the medical records had been obtained by the state government or an investigating agency through a lawful process, that did not by itself authorise their disclosure to the public.It also sought to know whether the reports were disclosed pursuant to any court order and, if not, what action had been taken against those who provided the documents. The notice further sought clarification on whether the reports made public were the original medical records.The issue dates back to the 2021 West Bengal assembly election, when Mamata Banerjee, then chief minister and the TMC candidate from Nandigram, sustained injuries near Birulia Bazar while campaigning.She subsequently campaigned from a wheelchair, and the nature and extent of her injuries became a major political issue during the election.After the TMC returned to power, Mamata Banerjee, who at the time secure a third successive term as chief minister, was seen walking.
Article Summary: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari alleged that Mamata Banerjee had "faked" her leg injury during the 2021 state assembly elections. The issue dates back to the 2021 West Bengal assembly election, when MamataBanerjee sustained injuries near Birulia Bazar while campaigning.

Article Title: ‘Silence any woman who dares to ask questions’: Rahul slams Delhi Police over sexual harassment complaints
Article Text:
Rahul Gandhi sl. ams Delhi Police over women journalists' complaints

What Delhi Police said about the protest

NEW DELHI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Monday accused the Delhi Police of mistreating women protesters and journalists during recent demonstrations in the national capital, after three women who identified themselves as journalists complained of alleged manhandling and sexual harassment by police personnel.In a post on X, Rahul Gandhi alleged that women were being silenced when they raised questions and demanded that CCTV footage from Saket police station be made public. He also sought action against police personnel accused of misconduct."What’s happening in Delhi right now follows a single pattern: silence any woman who dares to ask questions.Hundreds of people were detained at Jantar Mantar. Female protesters alleged that male police officers misbehaved with them. Cameras were snatched from female journalists, and they were dragged around. Not even an FIR was filed on a journalist’s complaint.A few weeks ago, Shaheen and Nafisa recounted their experiences of violence and mistreatment inside the Saket police station. Think about it—inside the station, the very place where women go to file complaints.Those entrusted with the responsibility of protecting women are now the ones posing a threat to them.And everyone in this country knows who the Delhi Police answers to.The entire CCTV footage from the Saket police station should be made public. Immediate action must be taken against the guilty police officers. Shaheen, Nafisa, and all those who have faced violence and rudeness from the Delhi Police must get justice.Mr Amit Shah—why are you and your police so afraid of women?"The Delhi Police, meanwhile, said three women journalists had submitted complaints alleging that they were manhandled by police officers and staff during their detention at a protest on October 3 against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Deputy commissioner of police Neha Yadav said the complaints had been registered, medical examinations conducted and the matter referred to the Crime Branch.“Around 6 PM, three women, who identified themselves as journalists, lodged a complaint alleging manhandling by Delhi Police officers and staff during their detention."“We request anyone possessing relevant footage to share it with the Crime Branch,” Yadav said.Delhi Police also confirmed that it had received complaints alleging sexual harassment by police personnel during the October 3 protest.“On 03-10-26, during the protest in New Delhi area, while being in law and order situation, allegations of sexual harassment were made by three female journalists against police officers. New Delhi District has received their complaints,” the police said in a post on X.According to police, protesters had been asked to vacate the site after Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita was imposed in the area. The protesters allegedly refused to comply and were subsequently detained.“Despite the imposition of Section 163 of the BNSS in the area, AISA and other parties staged a protest on October 3rd against the SIR. Protesters were warned to vacate the site, citing Section 163 of the BNSS; upon their refusal to comply, they were detained,” Yadav said.Several members of the All India Students' Association were detained by Delhi Police during the protest near Jantar Mantar. The demonstration was held against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar as protests over the SIR exercise continued in the capital.Several protesters, including AISA president Neha Bora and senior advocates Prashant Bhushan and Kapil Sibal, attempted to cross police barricades near Jantar Mantar, according to the police account.Delhi Police has registered at least three FIRs in connection with the mass protest held near Jantar Mantar on October 2. Two FIRs were registered at Parliament Street police station and one at Connaught Place police station.
Article Summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accused the Delhi Police of mistreating women protesters and journalists. Three women journalists complained of alleged manhandling and sexual harassment by police personnel. Delhi Police said three women journalists had submitted complaints alleging that they were manhandled by police officers and staff during their detention.

Article Title: Ex-TMC MP Koel Mallick joins BJP a day after being nominated for Rajya Sabha seat
Article Text:
Bengali film actor Koel Mallick joins BJP.

NEW DELHI: Bengali film actor Koel Mallick joined the BJP on Monday, a day after the party nominated her for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections.Mallick, daughter of veteran Bengali actor Ranjit Mallick, had earlier served as a TMC Rajya Sabha MP for a brief period from April 6 to July 16. She resigned after the Mamata Banerjee-led party's electoral setback in the assembly elections.West Bengal BJP general secretary Sashi Agnihotri welcomed Mallick into the party and said she would file her nomination for the Rajya Sabha seat on Monday.“It would be an honour for me to become a member of the Upper House of Parliament and get a chance to work for the welfare of the people,” Mallick said at a press conference at the BJP state headquarters.The actor said she wanted to be part of the development initiatives undertaken by the BJP government in West Bengal. She also thanked Prime Minister Narendra Modi and West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari for selecting her for the Rajya Sabha nomination.Asked about criticism over her decision to leave the TMC and join the BJP, Mallick said, “They are making such rude comments possibly because of their own vexations. I have no anger against them,” PTI reported.She said the new government was taking steps to create opportunities for Bengal's talent and prevent people from leaving the state, adding that she wanted to contribute to those efforts.“The root cause of increasing toxicity on social media is lack of work among the people,” she added.Responding to a question on whether joining the TMC had been a wrong decision, Mallick said, “Every party has its own ways of working and doing good. I feel enormously proud and privileged that I am now in a party which has undertaken welfare works for people in West Bengal in the past few months.”The bypolls for 12 Rajya Sabha seats across West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand are scheduled for October 16.
Article Summary: Mallick, daughter of veteran Bengali actor Ranjit Mallick, had earlier served as a TMC Rajya Sabha MP for a brief period from April 6 to July 16. She resigned after the Mamata Banerjee-led party's electoral setback in the assembly elections.

Article Title: 'I do not accept': Ex-Maha CM Chavan rejects Raj Thackeray’s election boycott call amid SIR row
Article Text:
Ex-Maha CM Chavan challenges Raj Thackeray’s Maharashtra strategy

Former Maharashtra chief minister and senior Congress leader Prithviraj Chavan on Sunday rejected Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) chief Raj Thackeray ’s call to boycott elections, saying participation in elections was a democratic right.“I do not accept that we should boycott the election. It is our right to a democratic government; that is not a correct strategy,” Chavan said.Chavan made the remarks amid a political confrontation over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Maharashtra and the functioning of the Election Commission. On Sunday, Raj Thackeray and Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray led a joint protest march in Mumbai against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, demanding the cancellation of the SIR exercise and raising questions over the poll panel’s functioning.Recalling the 2024 election, Chavan said he had raised concerns over alleged duplicate voters being added to electoral rolls and voting multiple times.“When my election took place in 2024, I protested, saying in my case duplicate voters were added who voted multiple times,” he said.Chavan further alleged that some minority and poor voters had been denied their voting rights, including people who supported the Congress.“In some places, minority voters were deprived of voting rights; in some places, poor people were deprived of voting rights; those who favoured the Congress party,” he said.“This is not vote chori; it is election chori,” Chavan alleged.His remarks came as the Thackeray cousins jointly led what was described as the ‘Virat Garjana Morcha’ in Mumbai, with Congress and NCP (SP) leaders also participating. Raj Thackeray called for the SIR exercise in Maharashtra to be scrapped and for elections to return to ballot papers.“Our demand is that the entire SIR conducted in Maharashtra should be cancelled,” Raj Thackeray said.“The law says that SIR is conducted if an emergency situation arises,” he said, questioning the circumstances in which the revision was undertaken.Raj Thackeray also alleged that 40 to 60 lakh voters were added during the Maharashtra Assembly elections and claimed that two crore voters were now being removed through SIR.“Forty to sixty lakh voters were added during the Assembly elections, and power was captured through this. And now, through SIR, two crore people are being removed. Who are these two crore voters?” he asked.Uddhav Thackeray separately questioned the appointment process for Election Commissioners and criticised the removal of the Chief Justice of India from the selection committee.“The first question is how was Gyanesh Kumar appointed?” Thackeray asked.The Election Commission has maintained that the electoral-roll revision is intended to update and clean the rolls, with mechanisms available for claims and objections.
Article Summary: Former Maharashtra chief minister Prithviraj Chavan rejects Raj Thackeray’s call to boycott elections. Chavan made the remarks amid a political confrontation over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Maharashtra and the functioning of the Election Commission. On Sunday, Raj Thackersay and Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackerays led a joint protest march against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke on Sunday said Mahatma Gandhi , Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar and Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru represented three distinct pillars of India’s political and social legacy.In a video post, Dipke described Gandhi as the “SOUL of India”, Ambedkar as the “BACKBONE of India” and Nehru as the “MIND of India”, adding, “You can never become like them.”The development comes as the CJP, led by founder Dipke, organised a protest at Mumbai’s Shivaji Park on Friday, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.Coinciding with Mahatma Gandhi’s birth anniversary, the protest stage displayed quotations on non-violence and simplicity, alongside tributes to Babasaheb Ambedkar.Mumbai Police have registered an FIR against the organisers and 400-500 unidentified persons in connection with the protest at Shivaji Park.The case has been registered under provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Maharashtra Police Act for unlawful assembly, wilful disobedience of a lawful order issued by a public servant and other offences, a Shivaji Park police station official said.The FIR was registered based on a complaint filed by a resident of the Shivaji Park area, the official added.Dipke on Friday night also announced a fresh protest at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar if Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar did not resign.“If Gyanesh Kumar doesn't resign, cockroaches from across India will march to Delhi & protest at Jantar Mantar on October 10,” he said in a post on X, adding that the protest would be peaceful and urging every citizen who wants free and fair elections to join it.

NEW DELHI : Delhi Police on Monday detained protesters outside Parliament Street Police Station who were demonstrating against an alleged incident of sexual misconduct against three women journalists during an October 3 protest at Jantar Mantar.The protesters were detained following a clash with police officers. One of the protesters stated that they had been demonstrating against the incident from 6:00 PM yesterday until 6:00 AM. The Police detained them at 7:00 in the morning.The protester further alleged that despite merely demanding the registration of an FIR, police personnel treated them poorly and took them into custody."We've been here since last night. All she wants is for an FIR to be filed," said protestors.Another protester alleged that police personnel have been using sticks inside to assault demonstrators, claiming that women and disabled persons were also beaten by police officials."They are beating the disabled person, they are beating the woman, a stick is being used inside," said another protester.Explaining the reason for their presence, one protester said that they had gathered at the spot to inquire about the status of the complaint regarding the October 3 assault incident."The police are misbehaving with us... We are here to ask for the status of our complaint after 48 hours..." said Protestors.Earlier, three women journalists alleged sexual harassment by police personnel during a protest at Jantar Mantar on October 3.Following the incident, Delhi Police received their complaints and transferred the matter to the Crime Branch, Kamla Market."On 03-10-26, during the protest in New Delhi area, while being in law and order situation, allegations of sexual harassment were made by three female journalists against police officers. NEW DELHI: Mumbai Police on Sunday registered an FIR against the organisers of the joint morcha led by Maharashtra Navnirman Sena and Shiv Sena (UBT) for not obtaining mandatory police clearance and violating prohibitory orders.The FIR was registered at the Azad Maidan police station after Uddhav Thackeray and Raj Thackeray led a joint protest march towards the BMC headquarters against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Uddhav said the protest was aimed at opposing what he described as an attack on voters' rights and democracy. And now, through SIR, two crore people are being removed. Who are these two crore voters?" he asked."I appeal to all political parties to go to Delhi and demand that the SIR should be cancelled. Article Title: Gulzar Singh case: Complainant has no video of father’s death, cops tell Punjab and Haryana high court
Article Text:
The report also states that in another video, Gulzar can be seen asking questions regarding the incident and its details.





CHANDIGARH: Punjab govt has told the Punjab and Haryana high court that despite repeated efforts, the original video/device on which alleged suicide victim Gulzar Singh’s purported video was recorded has not been handed over to the police by the complainant or his family members.In its status report filed before the division bench of Chief Justice Ashwini Kumar and Justice Rohit Kapoor, the state govt said efforts were made to bring on record the original video/device, but the complainant and the family members of Gulzar Singh did not submit them.The report states that notices under Section 94 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) were issued to complainant Lakhwinder Singh, who is Gulzar’s son, on Sept 15, 17, 20 and 27 for the production of the device. The report stated that Lakhwinder, in his statement on Sept 27, stated that he did not have any video regarding the death of his father.The SIT, however, said multiple videos had been collected as part of the investigation through social-media monitoring. “The said videos have been obtained through social monitoring vide DDR No. 45 dated September 26, 2026,” the report states.It states that the videos are being analysed as “there are multiple videos with different versions”.According to the status report, in one of the videos, Gulzar Singh is heard naming Raj Sarpanch, Vicky, Sukha Conductor and Gona, who are accused in the present FIR. The report states that “his statement in the said video corroborates with the statement given by complainant Lakhwinder Singh”.The report also states that in another video, Gulzar can be seen asking questions regarding the incident and its details.The police said notices were also issued under Section 94 of the BNSS to media channels, calling upon them to provide the original video recordings along with requisite certificates under Section 63(4)(c) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, “for the purpose of establishing their authenticity”.The status report has been filed by Sangrur senior superintendent of police Dr Rajvot Grewal, a member of the special investigation team that is probing the suicide case, in compliance with the high court’s Sept 16 order.The report states that FIR No. 204 dated Sept 8 was registered at Dirba police station under Section 108 of the BNS and sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(s) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against five persons — Baljit Singh alias Raj, Sukhdev Singh alias Sukha Conductor, Vicky Singh alias Vicky Member, Gona Singh and Baljinder Kaur.It states that Baljit, Vicky, Gona and Baljinder were arrested on Sept 8 and remanded in judicial custody. Sukhdev, however, “is absconding as on today”.Gulzar Singh, a 47-year-old agricultural laborer from Toor Banjara village in Punjab’s Sangrur district, died by suicide on Sept 7, after consuming poison following a public confrontation with Punjab finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema over the local drug menace on Sept 6.The SIT said a look-out circular was issued against Sukhdev, besides a message to all SHOs in Punjab, a public notice and letters to the Regional Transport Authority, Lead Bank, Sangrur, and Bureau of Immigration to trace him and gather information about his vehicle, financial transactions and travel history. Multiple raids were also conducted at his residence, relatives houses and other possible locations.A petition was filed before the Punjab and Haryana high court seeking transfer of the investigation to the CBI or another independent agency, alleging that Gulzar Singh had faced intimidation and that his video statement contained allegations against certain persons.
Article Summary: Gulzar Singh, a 47-year-old agricultural laborer from Toor Banjara village in Punjab’s Sangrur district, died by suicide on Sept 7, after consuming poison following a public confrontation with Punjab finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema.

Article Title: Raj Thackeray by side, Uddhav Thackeray asks: Why is CEC more protected than PM Modi?
Article Text:
Demanding reforms in the process of appointment of the poll chief, Uddhav questioned why the post is not subject to a vote.





MUMBAI: The scrapping of special intensive revisions (SIRs) of electoral rolls, a return to paper ballots, and elections for the post of the chief election commissioner (CEC) formed the core demands at the joint ‘Garjana’ protest rally organised by Shiv Sena (UBT) president Uddhav Thackeray and MNS chief Raj Thackeray on Sunday.Uddhav accused Kumar of acting as a “weapon” for BJP. He warned “BJP and these officials” of prosecution on the lines of the Nuremberg trials conducted for leaders of Nazi Germany. “[They] should realise that a similar thing will happen in the country.”Addressing a crowd of 8,000-10,000 that stretched from the Metro Cinema junction to the BMC headquarters in south Mumbai, the cousins called for structural changes to the electoral process.The demonstration was organised without any party flags; only the tricolour was allowed. Many netas from other MVA parties participated as well.Azad Maidan police later registered a case against the organisers for holding the rally without permission. The protest came two days after CJP’s stir in the city seeking CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s ouster.Uddhav sought data on the number of illegal Bangladeshis detected since SIRs began.“If SIRs were conducted to weed out Bangladeshis from the voters’ list, then how many of them residing illegally in the country did govt find?” He asked how so many illegal Bangladeshis as alleged reached Maharashtra in the first place when the border is controlled by the Centre.He alleged that 13 crore voters stand deleted nationwide from draft electoral rolls—“roughly equivalent to the entire population of Maharashtra”. Citing the case of West Bengal, where some deleted voters were restored to the rolls, Uddhav noted that re-checking all voters who have been left out nationwide would take “approximately 144 months”.Raj questioned the addition of nearly 1 crore votes for BJP in Maharashtra in the six months between the Lok Sabha elections and the assembly polls in 2024. “In those six months, 40-60 lakh votes were added to the rolls. BJP got 2.4 crore votes in the Lok Sabha elections and 3.1 crore in the assembly elections,” he said. He said fear of loss of people’s faith in them—thereby resulting in loss of votes—usually deters those in govt from engaging in such poll roll manipulations. “But this fear is non-existent in the state and Union govts,” he said.State NCP (SP) president Shashikanth Shinde asked what poll officials and state govt plan to do about the “2 crore voters declared bogus” who cast their votes in the assembly elections.Congress’s Balasaheb Thorat asserted that MVA’s loss in Maharashtra “was made possible only through the stealing of votes”. He said Rahul Gandhi, the leader of the opposition in the Lok Sabha, has been flagging “vote theft” for a long time and had also presented evidence of it. “All those who gained power did so through the theft of votes. They used various methods. Gyanesh Kumar is a symbol of this corrupt administration,” he alleged. “The period since 2014 (of NDA’s governance) will be remembered as a ‘dark period’ in the country’s history.”Demanding reforms in the process of appointment of the poll chief, Uddhav questioned why the post is not subject to a vote. “If we can have elections for the President, why can’t we have an election for the CEC who is responsible for conducting elections across the entire country?” Uddhav also criticised changes to the CEC selection panel. “The selection committee earlier used to comprise the PM, the CJI and the leader of the opposition, but now, they have replaced the CJI with a minister of govt’s choice. ” He questioned the legal protection granted to the CEC. “By law, the CEC cannot be hauled up and prosecuted for his time as the commissioner. Why does the CEC have such protection that even the PM doesn’t have?”Uddhav also spoke about the drought conditions in the state. “Today, Maharashtra is facing a famine. We can’t even imagine the condition of the famine-plagued farmer today.” Citing the case of one such farmer, Jijabai Kachate, he said she planted soybean in her field in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, which failed. “She then planted chillies, which too failed. Later, she planted corn, which also failed. The loans piled up. The banks came calling. And then her son died by suicide in the same field. The same field where she saw her future, she saw her son’s final rites,” he said.While Raj’s son, Amit, attended the rally, Uddhav’s son, Aaditya, was unwell and could not attend it, said Shiv Sena (UBT) functionaries. Police invoked Sections 223 (disobedience to order duly promulgated by a public servant), 189 (unlawful assembly) and 190 (every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object) of BNS in the case filed against the protest’s organisers.
Article Summary: Uddhav accused Kumar of acting as a “weapon” for BJP. He warned “BJP and these officials’ of prosecution on the lines of the Nuremberg trials conducted for leaders of Nazi Germany. The protest came two days after CJP’s stir in the city seeking CEC Gyanesh Kumar”s ouster.

Article Title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke backs UBT-MNS protest rally, asks all Indians to come together
Article Text:
Abhijeet Dipke

Mumbai:





Backing the Shiv Sena (UBT)-MNS protest, held two days after Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) stir against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, the outfit’s founder, Abhijeet Dipke, on Sunday said the city is out on the streets again for free and fair elections. “Solidarity with all the protesters. All Indians need to come together. It’s now or never!” he said in a post on X.Again contrasting police’s handling of protests in Delhi and Mumbai, Dipke said, “Don’t ask how protests are being allowed in Mumbai. There’s a big cultural difference between Maharashtra Police & Delhi Police.” He had earlier showered praise on Mumbai police during CJP’s protest at Shivaji Park on Oct 2, calling it the best police force in the country.
Article Summary: Abhijeet Dipke backed the Shiv Sena (UBT)-MNS protest, held two days after Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) stir against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. “Solidarity with all the protesters. All Indians need to come together. It's now or never!” he said in a post on X.

Article Title: ​​Unrest within BJP as Bawankule hints at offering Aurangabad division graduates’ poll seat to NCP
Article Text:
Sitting MLC Satish Chavan has already started his campaign for ​​Aurangabad Division Graduates’ constituency poll

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Several BJP politicains have been feeling unsettled since revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule hinted at giving up the party’s claim over Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency poll on Friday.Bawankule said that Mahayuti has decided that the seat won by the party in the grand alliance would remain with the same party, indicating that NCP would have a claim over the seat.While no official announcement of the candidate has been made yet from the Mahayuti camp, sitting MLC of Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency, Satish Chavan has already started his poll campaign.The comment made by Bawankule, which reflected a larger understanding of top leaders from BJP-NCP, has produced unrest as well as gloom within the BJP camp as its leaders were trying hard to wrest the seat from NCP.“We have left no stone unturned to ensure maximum voter registration for the upcoming MLC poll with the hope of a BJP candidate getting a ticket. We have already paid multiple visits to top leaders to convey our sentiments. Despite hints from Bawankule, we hope for a miracle to happen at the last moment,” a BJP leader from Marathwada said.The BJP camp from Marathwada had repeatedly raised the fact that Chavan had unsuccessfully contested the 2024 assembly poll from Gangapur against Mahayuti.Gangapur BJP MLA Prashant Bamb was among the party leaders who were openly opposing a Mahayuti ticket to Chavan.If the BJP gives up its claim, it will be the first time in the history that the the party will not be in the fray for the Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency poll.On Saturday, a total of 31 aspirants collected 59 nomination forms for ​Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency poll, and ten candidates filed their papers. So far, 174 forms have been issued to 97 aspirants and 12 candidates have filed nominations, according to official data.
Article Summary: Several BJP politicains have been feeling unsettled since revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule hinted at giving up the party’s claim over Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency poll. No official announcement of the candidate has been made yet from the Mahayuti camp.

Article Title: Bhaiyya Mane breaks with Mushrif, NCP over Pune Graduate seat
Article Text:
Kolhapur





:District Cooperative Bank director Pratap Mane, popularly known as ‘Bhaiyya Mane’, has parted ways with minister Hasan Mushrif and the NCP amid uncertainty in Mahayuti over the nomination for the Pune Graduate constituency.Mane, a long-time supporter of Mushrif, has decided to contest the election irrespective of whether he gets the party nomination. He became emotional while announcing his decision.Mushrif on Saturday said, “Mane had undertaken substantial voter-registration work over the past five years and NCP had sought the nomination for him. However, NCP MLC Arun Lad had joined BJP , while CM Fadnavis had assured the candidature to Lad’s son, Sharad Lad, making it likely that the seat would go to BJP.”Mushrif said he had tried to persuade Mane, but the latter asked him not to stand in the way of his political future. “My relationship with Mane has ended. NCP will have to work for Mahayuti as a constituent of the alliance,” he said.Mane, however, said there was no question of withdrawing from the contest as he had been preparing for the election for several years. He also highlighted his role in securing Rs 50 crore for infrastructure development at Shivaji University.Mane acknowledged that NCP might have faced limitations in securing the seat and said the situation could have been different had Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar been alive.Mane’s supporters had earlier expressed displeasure over Mahayuti’s failure to decide its candidate and urged him to contest either on a party ticket or as an independent.Suggestions were also made that Mushrif should submit voter-registration data to senior leaders, allow Mane to contest independently and ask Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar to permit a friendly contest within Mahayuti. With the candidature issue unresolved, Mane eventually left Mushrif’s camp.NCP had won the Pune Graduate seat in the previous election. However, BJP Rajya Sabha MP Dhananjay Mahadik has claimed the seat for BJP following Lad’s switch from NCP. Mahadik has said BJP will contest both the Pune Graduate and Teachers constituencies.Several members of the Shiv Sena factions are also interested in contesting the two constituencies. Their next move remains under scrutiny amid indications that both seats could go to BJP.
Article Summary: Pratap Mane, popularly known as ‘Bhaiyya Mane’, has parted ways with minister Hasan Mushrif and the NCP. NCP MLC Arun Lad had joined BJP, while CM Fadnavis had assured the candidature to Lad’s son, Sharad Lad.

Article Title: Man in Mahindra Thar with duplicate plate molests woman, knocks down another in Kharghar
Article Text:
30-year-old man was apprehended for allegedly molesting a woman and injuring another in Navi Mumbai.





NAVI MUMBAI: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team within 10 hours on Thursday evening.He had allegedly molested a 26-year-old woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night and, an hour later, severely injured a 22-year-old woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, Kharghar.Acting on a complaint by the woman allegedly molested by the Thar SUV driver, Kharghar police registered an FIR under BNS section 74 for the offence of assault or criminal force against a woman with the intent to outrage her modesty.While, as per the complaint by the injured woman Shrawani Dandekar, a resident of sector 3, Belpada, an FIR under relevant BNS sections and Motor Vehicle Act was registered against the Thar SUV driver for rash and negligent driving causing hurt.The detained aaccused identified as Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of sector 50, Seawoods, Nerul was handed over to Kharghar police for further legal action.Previously, in January 2021, he was arrested by Nerul police in the FIR registered against him for alleged kidnapping, sexual harassment and molestation of a woman.Sanjay Joshi, senior inspector of Kharghar said, "The accused Nakhvi has been detained and subsequently it will be decided whether to arrest him or serve with a notice under Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for cooperating in police investigating."Audumbar Patil, senior inspector of crime branch unit-3 said, "After an FIR for molestation was registered at Kharghar police station by the victim woman, a resident of sector 34, Kharghar. As per the orders of higher authority, our team started a parallel probe. From the CCTV camera surveillance near the crime scene, we obtained the red Thar SUV's registration number, which was of Vashi RTO passing.""When verified, the registration number was found to be that of a Maruti WagonR car. As the accused had used a duplicate registration number plate, we scrutinized as many as 62 Thar SUVs registered with various Regional Transport Offices (RTOs). Subsequently, we obtained the registration number of a red Thar SUV that was registered with Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar RTO," Patil added.SPI Patil further informed, "The SUV was registered in the name of Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of Devaki Apartment in sector-50, Seawoods. From his mobile number registered with the RTO, his location was tracked.""He was apprehended from Bonkode village, Koparkhairane on Thursday late evening. Upon thorough interrogation, he confessed that he had inappropriately touched the woman pedestrian near Pethpada metro station while he drove his Thar SUV and sped away. He even confessed to have injured a woman pedestrian by hitting her his SUV while driving in Belpada area," he said.
Article Summary: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team on Thursday evening. He had allegedly molested a woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night. An hour later, he severely injured a woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, KharGHar.

Article Title: Thane Shiv Sena (UBT) leader murder: 2 more arrested near Alibag while fleeing to Goa, total 3
Article Text:
Two additional suspects were arrested in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena division chief Pradeep Purnekar.





THANE: The Thane Crime Branch has arrested two more accused in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena (UBT) division chief Pradeep alias Balu Purnekar, taking the total number of arrests in the case to three.The arrested accused have been identified as Nikhil Yadav and Nitesh Pawar alias Bhavdya. The two were apprehended near Alibag while allegedly attempting to flee towards Goa, according to police sources.The Crime Branch reportedly traced the duo following information obtained during the questioning of suspects detained earlier in the case. Police teams had been searching for the accused after Purnekar was shot and attacked with a sharp-edged weapon at his office in Thane.According to investigators, Yadav allegedly opened fire on Purnekar, while Pawar allegedly attacked him with a sharp weapon. Police are now expected to question both accused to establish the sequence of events, the motive and the role of others involved in the alleged conspiracy.The two accused are expected to be produced before the Thane Sessions Court on Friday. Police will also attempt to recover the weapons allegedly used in the murder and investigate how the accused obtained them.Earlier, Prakash alias Papya Shinde was arrested in connection with the case. The police have also formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) headed by DCP (Crime) Amarsingh Jadhav to conduct a detailed probe into the killing.The investigation is continuing, with police probing the alleged conspiracy, the role of other suspects and the possible involvement of the absconding accused.
Article Summary: The arrested accused have been identified as Nikhil Yadav and Nitesh Pawar alias Bhavdya. The two were apprehended near Alibag while allegedly attempting to flee towards Goa. Police are now expected to question both accused to establish the sequence of events, the motive and the role of others involved.

Article Title: Disha Salian case: Father, lawyer seek police protection, allege threats from Sena (UBT) leaders
Article Text:
Ojha questioned Aaditya Thackeray’s ‘Y-plus’ security, saying those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

(With agency inputs)





THANE: Advocate Nilesh Ojha on Sunday said that Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection, alleging that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders.Ojha, who is representing Satish Salian in the case, said they have written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), the Chief Justice of India and Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis, seeking protection."The CBI FIR was registered, and a letter was immediately written requesting police protection for four individuals: Satish Salian, our witness Sameer Wankhede, myself, and Ashutosh Pathak, " Ojha told news agency ANI.Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray , saying those who brought the matter to light and allegedly faced threats had been left without protection."The letter clearly states, citing records from your Home Ministry and the Narcotics Bureau, that it is evident that Aditya Thackeray is involved in the drug trade. Furthermore, an FIR has now been registered against him regarding gang rape, murder, and a cover-up.Several other high-profile individuals and police officers are also implicated as accused in this matter," he said."We have already provided all prima facie evidence; the CBI has obtained everything necessary during the investigation to secure a conviction. Yet, the accused currently enjoys 'Y-plus' security provided by your administration. Meanwhile, those who brought this matter to light and those facing direct threats from individuals like Sanjay Raut were left unprotected," the advocate added.He further said that providing security was mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines, and alleged that their request for protection had not been acted upon.He further added, "Providing security is mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines. Yet, they failed to do so. Consequently, we compiled all the material and handed it over to the CBI. We also urged them to investigate the role of Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and determine why police protection was not granted.""We have given a copy of this to the CBI, along with Prime Minister Modi ji, the Home Minister, the Chief Justice of India, and the Chief Minister," Ojha said.Disha Salian was found dead in Mumbai on June 8, 2020. Her death was initially registered as an Accidental Death Report (ADR).Salian died days before actor Sushant Singh Rajput , whose death also led to a high-profile investigation and widespread public controversy.Bombay High Court directed the CBI to register a formal First Information Report (FIR) and launch a fresh probe.As the probe progresses, Satish Salian, accompanied by his lawyer Nilesh Ojha, has submitted a pen drive containing material they described as evidence related to Disha Salian’s death.Meanwhile, Aaditya Thackeray has denied the allegations and responded to the defamation notice issued by Satish Salian.
Article Summary: Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection. They allege that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders. Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray. He said those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

Article Title: 'BJP winning in states it couldn't even at peak of Modi wave': Abhijeet Dipke says ‘no point’ in polls
Article Text:
Dipke urged the CEC to resign, claiming that election results in the country had become "predetermined" and that participation in such polls had therefore become meaningless.

(With inputs from ANI)





PUNE: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activist Abhijeet Dipke alleged that the BJP is winning in states where it could not secure victories even during the peak of the "Modi wave", attributing the outcome to alleged institutional manipulation under chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar."The BJP is winning in states where it couldn't even secure a victory during the peak of the 'Modi wave' and this is happening because of Gyanesh Kumar. Once Gyanesh Kumar leaves and the SIR freezes, only then will we know how many seats the BJP actually wins," Dipke told reporters on Sunday.Dipke urged the CEC to resign, claiming that election results in the country had become "predetermined" and that participation in such polls had therefore become meaningless."I feel that until Gyanesh Kumar resigns and ensures free and fair elections, there is no point in participating in such polls, because the winner is already predetermined," he said.Dipke made the remarks during his visit to Pune to express solidarity with students protesting against the Maharashtra government over alleged irregularities in Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) examinations and recruitment backlogs.He linked the issue surrounding the polls to alleged administrative failures under the ruling dispensation and claimed that public trust in both competitive examinations and electoral processes had collapsed.Seeking the resignation of the MPSC Chairman, Dipke said, "I have come here to meet protesting students. Their future is in question because there are continuous cases of paper leaks. The government is not serious about these leaks. CJP supports their demands, and till MPSC chairman resigns, this protest will continue."
Article Summary: Dipke urged the CEC to resign, claiming that election results in the country had become "predetermined" and that participation in such polls had therefore become meaningless. He made the remarks during his visit to Pune to express solidarity with students protesting against the Maharashtra government over alleged irregularities.

Article Title: NCP (SP) will clarify stand on SIR issue soon, wrongdoers must be held accountable: Sharad Pawar
Article Text:
Sharad Pawar

Pune:





NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar on Sunday spoke on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) controversy, saying his party would clarify its stance on the issue in the coming days. The senior politician added that they stand with all those who want to take action against wrongdoers in this entire process.He was speaking to the media after a meeting at his home in Shivajinagar with protesting MPSC students.Replying to a question from reporters about his views on the agitation in Mumbai led by Uddhav Thackeray and Raj Thackeray, bringing up the issue of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the SIR of electoral rolls, Pawar said the controversy extends far beyond Mumbai and across Maharashtra The Mumbai demonstration was organised to demand the CEC’s resignation while objecting to the Election Commission ’s implementation of the voter-list revision.Pawar said political leaders across parties should unite to resolve issues around the SIR process and hold wrongdoers accountable.
Article Summary: NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar spoke on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) controversy. He said his party would clarify its stance on the issue in the coming days. The senior politician added that they stand with all those who want to take action against wrongdoers in this entire process.

Article Title: 6 convicted for trafficking and sexually assaulting woman, 4 get 20-yr jail
Article Text:
Ai image

Nagpur:





A special court sentenced four men to 20 years of rigorous imprisonment (RI) each and awarded seven years’ RI each to two others in a trafficking and repeated sexual assault case involving a 21-year-old woman in 2022. Out of the 12 accused in the case, five remain absconding and one was acquitted.Those awarded 20 years’ RI are Ashok Sharma (42), Sanjay Parikh (36), Vijay Soni (35) and Mukesh Kumar Jakhar (27). The court also imposed fines, with additional imprisonment in case of non-payment, under the respective offences.Annukhan alias Muskan Khan (22) and Geeta Saini (38) were sentenced to seven years’ RI for offences related to trafficking. Fines and additional imprisonment in default of payment were also imposed.Special Ad-hoc Judge-18 J C Yadav passed the order on Oct 3 in the case registered with Pachpaoli police station. The court convicted the accused on the basis of witness testimony and other evidence presented by the prosecution.As per the prosecution, the woman met Annukhan while seeking a catering job between Sept 2021 and Jan 2022. She was allegedly lured to Jaipur with the promise of employment.She was allegedly confined in a lodge and threatened. She was allegedly handed over to other accused, forcibly married off and subjected to repeated sexual assault and torture, the prosecution said.The case was registered under provisions dealing with abducting a woman, wrongful confinement, trafficking, repeated rape and criminal intimidation. The accused were arrested between Jan 5 and Feb 22 in 2022.Karan Sukhpal Gangaboir alias Salman Khan, Bhagwati Devi Ashok Sharma, Sagar Garhwal, Shyam Gurulia and Durga Rana Gopal Singh Rana did not appear for the proceedings. A charge sheet was filed against them under provisions relating to absconding accused, and further action will be taken upon their arrest. Shireen Khan Aziz Khan (19) was acquitted.The prosecution, represented by the addl public prosecutor Rashmi Khaparde, examined 10 witnesses. The then investigating officer PM Dhakulkar filed the charge sheet after completing the investigation. Woman police constable Apeksha Bodele assisted in the court proceedings.
Article Summary: Out of the 12 accused in the case, five remain absconding and one was acquitted. Ashok Sharma (42), Sanjay Parikh (36), Vijay Soni (35) and Mukesh Kumar Jakhar (27) were awarded 20 years’ RI. Annukhan alias Muskan Khan (22) and Geeta Saini (38) were sentenced to seven years' RI for offences related to trafficking.

Article Title: Shiv Sena group leader in Akola civic body arrested for alleged Rs15L extortion demand
Article Text: Akola: An offence was registered against Shiv Sena (Eknath Shinde) group leader in Akola Municipal Corporation, Sagar Bharuka, for allegedly creating a ruckus at a hotel and demanding Rs15 lakh from its owner. Civil Lines police arrested Bharuka late on Sunday night, and he is expected to be produced before a court.The case was registered on the basis of a complaint filed by hotel employee Shoeb Akhtar Jameel Akhtar, who works at the hotel in the bus stand area.As per the complaint, Bharuka allegedly visited the hotel at around midnight on Oct 3 and asked for food. The complainant told police that he informed Bharuka that food could not be served as the hotel’s kitchen had closed at around 11.30pm. Akhtar told the media that Bharuka abused him and created a commotion.On the extortion allegation, Akhtar said there was no direct demand but Bharuka told him that he could demand money from the hotel owner and referred to a demand of Rs15 lakh. The alleged extortion demand forms part of the complaint and is yet to be established through investigation.Akola sub-divisional police officer Sudarshan Patil said police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident and the alleged demand. Bharuka refuted the allegations and claimed there is a vested political interest behind the complaint.Police are likely to examine the statements of the complainant, hotel owner, employees and other witnesses, besides checking available evidence.
Article Summary: Sagar Bharuka, a Shiv Sena group leader in Akola Municipal Corporation, was arrested on Sunday night. The case was registered on the basis of a complaint filed by hotel employee Shoeb Akhtar Jameel Akhtar, who works at the hotel in the bus stand area.

Article Title: Youth assaulted at Jargaon gram sabha after questioning lack of fogging, case against former sarpanch & 2 others
Article Text:
Nashik

:





A question over why a village fogging machine was lying unused allegedly led to the assault of a youth during a special gram sabha at Jargaon in Pachora taluka on Friday.Pachora police registered a case against former sarpanch Sunil Patil and two of his relatives following a complaint by Anand Patil. Police took the two relatives into custody, while the former sarpanch was not traceable.The special Gram Sabha was convened on Gandhi Jayanti to discuss development works, civic amenities and public grievances. During the meeting, Anand raised the growing mosquito menace and questioned why the fogging machine was not being used.Police said this sparked a heated argument between Anand and the former sarpanch, which soon escalated into an alleged physical assault.A video of the altercation later was circulated on social media, triggering outrage in the area.Following Anand’s complaint, Pachora police booked the three under BNS sections 115(2) for voluntarily causing hurt and 352 for intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace.Jargaon police patil Namdeo Patil said Anand owns a house in the village, which has a population of around 15,000.The Jargaon Gram Panchayat is currently being run by an administrator.
Article Summary: A question over why a village fogging machine was lying unused allegedly led to the assault of a youth during a special gram sabha at Jargaon in Pachora taluka on Friday. Police registered a case against former sarpanch Sunil Patil and two of his relatives.

Article Title: Former AIADMK MLA joins TVK, says party was “drifting away from its path”
Article Text:
Two-time AIADMK MLA from Kattumannarkoil N Murugumaran joined TVK

Chennai:





Two-time AIADMK MLA from Kattumannarkoil N Murugumaran joined TVK on Sunday. In a letter to AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami , Murugumaran said that he was quitting primary membership of AIADMK “with pain” because the party was “drifting away from its path”.Within hours of sending the letter, Murugumaran met TVK general secretary N Anand and joined TVK. AIADMK sources said that he was upset with Palaniswami as he was allotted Thittakudi assembly constituency instead of Kattumannarkoil which he had sought.“The party which was led by ideological leaders has lost its principles and was guided by money,” Murugumaran charged. He also alleged that AIADMK suffered a rift due to the “leadership’s decision to align with DMK”.
Article Summary: Two-time AIADMK MLA from Kattumannarkoil N Murugumaran joined TVK on Sunday. In a letter toAIADMK general secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami, he said he was quitting primary membership of the party ‘with pain’ He alleged that the party had lost its principles and was guided by money.

Article Title: FIR against Udhayanidhi Stalin for involving child in poll campaign in Dharapuram
Article Text:
Authorities in Dharapuram have filed a case against Udhayanidhi Stalin for infringing on the Model Code of Conduct during a recent election rally





TIRUPUR: Dharapuram Police have registered a case against Tamil Nadu Assembly Opposition Leader Udhayanidhi Stalin for involving a child in an election campaign meeting at Dharapuram, where the Model Code of Conduct is in force for the bypoll.According to a press release issued by Tirupur district police, the incident took place on Saturday near the Periyar statue in Dharapuram town during an election campaign meeting addressed by Udhayanidhi.Police said the Election Commission had clearly instructed political parties and candidates not to involve children in any election-related activities.Police said Udhayanidhi made a child speak at the campaign meeting in a manner that was insulting to Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay and also used the child for election campaigning.Dharapuram Town Police registered a case against Udhayanidhi. Further investigation is under way, police said.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu Assembly Opposition Leader Udhayanidhi Stalin involved a child in an election campaign meeting at Dharapuram. The Model Code of Conduct is in force for the bypoll. Police said the Election Commission had clearly instructed political parties and candidates not to involve children in election-related activities.

Article Title: Six arrested in Coimbatore for possessing synthetic drug, ganja
Article Text: COIMBATORE: In two separate cases, the Coimbatore city police on Friday arrested six men on charges of possessing synthetic drug methamphetamine and ganja.On Friday evening, the Sundarapuram police seized 58 gram of methamphetamine from three men and arrested them. The arrested men have been identified as B Annamalai, 25, of Kurichi Housing Unit, R Arunpandi, 27, of Madurai and A Gopinath, 21 of Dindigul.Based on specific information about synthetic drug sales, the Sundarapuram police reached Mohan Nagar on the Madukkarai Main Road and began a search. They found the trio under a flyover. Upon checking them, police found 58 grams of methamphetamine in their possession.A case was registered under Section 8(c) read with Section 22(c) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act (NDPS Act). They were remanded in judicial custody.In a separate incident, Ukkadam police arrested R Arun, 20 of Sivagangai District, S Bhuvanesh, 22 of Theni and K Raman, 23 of Madurai and seized 3.6 kg of ganja from them. The trio were remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: Coimbatore city police on Friday arrested six men on charges of possessing synthetic drug methamphetamine and ganja. On Friday evening, the Sundarapuram police seized 58 gram of methamphetamine from three men and arrested them. In a separate incident, Ukkadam police arrested R Arun, 20 of Sivagangai District, S Bhuvanesh, 22 of Theni and K Raman, 23 of Madurai.

Article Title: Tamil Nadu’s economy heading towards abyss under Vijay’s TVK govt: BJP
Article Text:
Nainar Nagenthran





COIMBATORE: BJP state president Nainar Nagenthran on Friday alleged that the Tamil Nadu ’s economy has deteriorated under TVK govt and is “heading towards the abyss.” He accused the TVK regime of functioning largely as a “social media govt.”Nagenthran was in Pollachi to pay floral tributes to Mahatma Gandhi on the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti. Speaking to reporters later, he launched a broadside against TVK govt and chief minister C Joseph Vijay. He said that during the first 144 days of TVK govt, around 500 crimes had been reported. He alleged that 30 people associated with the party were accused in rape cases and no action had been taken against them.He said BJP would continue to expand its political presence in Tamil Nadu and claimed that the party would eventually establish its “full authority” in the state.Asked about the bypolls in Dharapuram and Madurantakam, Nagenthran alleged that the resignation of MLAs after getting elected amounted to “horse-trading.” He held chief minister Vijay responsible for this and demanded a judicial inquiry into the alleged horse-trading.Nagenthran stated that the state was facing power shortages and increased power cuts, affecting industrial units. He alleged that govt had failed to introduce adequate welfare and development schemes for the people. “There is no people-oriented governance. There is nothing for the welfare of the people,” he said.

Article Title: 864 bottles of liquor seized from house near Erode; man arrested
Article Text: ERODE: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district in the early hours of Thursday and arrested a man.Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid at the house of K Govindaraj, 28, of Ammapalayam. They found 864 bottles of IMFL stocked in the house for illegal sale.Police registered a case and arrested Govindaraj. He was remanded in judicial custody.They launched a search for Sekar alias Ammasai, 34, and Sridhar, 38, who have links with the illegal liquor operation.
Article Summary: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district. Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid.

Article Title: Couple held in FQL scam detained under Goondas Act
Article Text:
Couple held in FQL scam detained under Goondas Act





Madurai: A couple accused in the FQL online investment scam in Melur were detained under the Goondas Act on Sunday.Madurai district collector Nishant Krishna issued orders to detain Ranjith , 29, and Priyadharshini, 23, under the Act.Thousands of people lost money after investing through FQL platform on the promise that their investments would double.Economic offences wing (EOW) superintendent of police (south zone) K Saravana Kumar recommended that the couple be detained under the Goondas Act. Subsequently, Madurai collector issued detention orders. The orders were served on the couple, who were already in prison.

Article Title: Traffic affected on Salem-Madurai National Highway after trailer truck crashes near Rasipuram
Article Text: NAMAKKAL: Traffic was affected for more than an hour on the Salem-Madurai National Highway near Rasipuram in Namakkal district on Thursday afternoon after a trailer truck crashed while descending the Andagalur Gate flyover.No casualties or injuries were reported.The truck was carrying about 60 tonnes of steel angles from Maharashtra to Karur. An officer at the Rasipuram police station said the driver lost control of the vehicle while descending the flyover around 1.30pm. The truck hit a streetlight pole on the roadside. “The vehicle partially blocked the road, causing congestion and delays for motorists and commuters,” he said.Vehicles piled up for two kilometres on the NH. The Rasipuram police reached the spot after receiving information, regulated traffic and moved the truck to the roadside.Police registered a case and were investigating the circumstances leading to the crash.
Article Summary: Trailer truck crashes on Salem-Madurai National Highway near Rasipuram. Truck was carrying 60 tonnes of steel angles from Maharashtra to Karur. Driver lost control of the vehicle while descending the flyover. No casualties or injuries were reported.

Article Title: Man held for sexual assault of transwoman, extortion
Article Text:
Kochi

:





Palarivattom Police arrested a 21-year-old man on Sunday for allegedly sexually assaulting a transwoman and extorting Rs 1.18 lakh by threatening to circulate her intimate photographs and videos on the social media.The accused was arrested from Tanur on Sunday morning. The police said he befriended the transwoman through the social media and allegedly sexually assaulted her in June 2026. He reportedly recorded nude photographs of her on his mobile phone, sent them to her and threatened to share them publicly unless she paid him money.The police said several nude videos involving other women were found on the phone seized from the accused. He was arrested while out on bail in a Pocso case, said an officer.The accused was produced before the Ernakulam judicial first class magistrate court-IX and remanded in judicial custody for 14 days.
